title: Fuchs & Unger Jewellery
author: Zoran Grabovac
description:
This is the score of your life, promised to you by someone you've never met. They've offered a massive payout, if you can figure out how to get it.

In The Heist, you team up with a shady character known only as "Cal" to solve puzzles and coordinate the stealing of a massive, valuable jewel from Fuchs & Unger Jewellery company.

Do you have the skill to figure it out?
